{{quote|Peace favor your sword|Shienaran warrior's blessing}}

{{quote|Flowers can kill in the Blight, and leaves maim. There's a little thing called a Stick that likes to hide where the leaves are thickest, looking like its name, waiting for something to touch it. When something does, it bites. Not poison. The juice begins to digest the Stick's prey for it. The only thing that can save you is to cut off the arm or leg that was bitten. But a Stick won't bite unless you touch it. Other things in the Blight will.|[[al'Lan Mandragoran]]}}

==Summary==
{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}

[[File:Lan.png|thumb|left|120px|"All I have is a sword, and a war I cannot win, but can never stop fighting." - [[al'Lan Mandragoran]]]]

[[Ingtar Shinowa|Ingtar]] leads an escort of Shienaran lances under the Gray Owl banner for [[Moiraine Damodred|Moiraine]] and the group headed to the [[Eye of the World]]. He halts the lances at the [[Blightborder]] that was once [[Malkier]] and appears unhappy at his previous orders to go no further, saddened by the prospect of missing the Battle at [[Tarwin's Gap]],{{ref/book|1|51}} angry that the [[Emond's Field]] folk get to travel the [[Great Blight|Blight]] with [[Al'Lan Mandragoran|Lan]]. [[Rand al'Thor|Rand]] thinks back to the soldiers heading toward the Blight, the non-combatants reluctantly heading south in case the worst happens as Ingtar leaves them.

The group travels north at the [[Warder]]'s pace. They notice that the weather is warmer, and wrong at the same time. The party finds the heat stifling, and hard to breathe in; all except [[Perrin Aybara|Perrin]] and Lan. Rand reaches out to touch a sickly looking tree and earns a rebuke from the Warder. They travel further into the Blight, the corruption growing worse with each step. [[Mat Cauthon|Mat]] retches multiple times. [[Loial]] is disgusted at the corrupted trees. Lan announces that they will not reach the mountains by nightfall, prompting the [[Aes Sedai]] to suggest a nearby area as a camp site. It would be a good omen to camp there.

They camp not too far from a lake. Nynaeve and Mat ask why they do not camp closer to the lake, but then they see a writhing tentacled creature emerge from the surface before eventually going back below, answering their question. This is one of Malkier's Thousand Lakes. Moiraine uses the [[One Power]] to bend light around their location and set [[ward]]s around them. The light bending confuses the boys briefly, as it sometimes causes the women to disappear. [[Egwene al'Vere|Egwene]] says she will learn to do this in Tar Valon; [[Nynaeve al'Meara|Nynaeve]] tentatively suggests she will go there as well, under the pretense of accompanying Egwene. Egwene says Rand will be her Warder when she becomes [[Aes Sedai]], which Rand goes along with even though he remembers that [[Min Farshaw|Min]] told him that he and Egwene would not be for each other.

Rand has trouble sleeping and eavesdrops on a personal conversation between [[Nynaeve al'Meara|Nynaeve]] and Lan in which they both profess feelings for the other, but Lan refuses to accept her love. Lan believes he is doomed to die fighting the Shadow. Rand closes his eyes after seeing his [[Wisdom]] cry.
